================================================================================
Assert module calls
================================================================================

assert.true(True)
assert.fail("x")
assert.lt(a, b)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(module
  (expression_statement
    (call
      (attribute
        (identifier)
        (identifier))
      (argument_list
        (true))))
  (expression_statement
    (call
      (attribute
        (identifier)
        (identifier))
      (argument_list
        (string
          (string_start)
          (string_content)
          (string_end)))))
  (expression_statement
    (call
      (attribute
        (identifier)
        (identifier))
      (argument_list
        (identifier)
        (identifier)))))

================================================================================
Assert used as a name
================================================================================

assert = module("assert", eq = _eq)
assert.eq(1, 1)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(module
  (expression_statement
    (assignment
      (identifier)
      (call
        (identifier)
        (argument_list
          (string
            (string_start)
            (string_content)
            (string_end))
          (keyword_argument
            (identifier)
            (identifier))))))
  (expression_statement
    (call
      (attribute
        (identifier)
        (identifier))
      (argument_list
        (integer)
        (integer)))))

================================================================================
Assert helpers are ordinary calls and names
================================================================================

assert_eq(a, b)
assert_fails(f, "msg")
assert_ = 1

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(module
  (expression_statement
    (call
      (identifier)
      (argument_list
        (identifier)
        (identifier))))
  (expression_statement
    (call
      (identifier)
      (argument_list
        (identifier)
        (string
          (string_start)
          (string_content)
          (string_end)))))
  (expression_statement
    (assignment
      (identifier)
      (integer))))

================================================================================
Ambiguous forms prefer the ordinary reading
================================================================================

assert(x)
assert[0]
assert - x

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(module
  (expression_statement
    (call
      (identifier)
      (argument_list
        (identifier))))
  (expression_statement
    (subscript
      (identifier)
      (integer)))
  (expression_statement
    (binary_operator
      (identifier)
      (identifier))))

================================================================================
Unambiguous assert statements still parse
================================================================================

assert x == y, "msg"

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(module
  (assert_statement
    (assert_keyword)
    (comparison_operator
      (identifier)
      (identifier))
    (string
      (string_start)
      (string_content)
      (string_end))))
